## Summary

Fixed the AUDIT: REJECT on PR #78 (`worker/task-20260726-071221-close-worker-false-self-report-gap-in-ph`):

1. **`confirm_merge()`** now returns a 4th `ambiguous` flag, distinguishing a definitive "gh confirmed NOT merged" from "the gh call itself failed" (bad returncode / unparseable JSON). Only the definitive case is eligible for revert.
2. **`find_first_unverified_done_block()`** treats `ambiguous=True` as skip-with-warning (never a revert trigger), and now also flags phases with no `target_repo` field at all instead of silently passing them — both recorded into a new `warnings` list exposed in the JSON output.
3. **`audit_and_correct_plan_file()`** now records a real incident (not just a stderr warning) when a violation is found but can't be auto-corrected — including the from-scratch fabricated-block case (phase absent from the parent revision entirely), the most direct reproduction of the original phase_4/PR#562 incident.
4. Added 3 new test scenarios covering all three fixes, plus `test_*` pytest wrapper functions (the file previously had zero pytest-collectible tests — `pytest` was silently collecting 0 items and exiting 5).

All 39 assertions pass standalone and `python3 -m pytest tests/backfill_phase_self_report_test.py -v` exits 0 with 10 tests passing. Pushed directly to the existing PR #78 branch (commit `fd3ddf1`) — no new PR opened. Per the task constraints, I have not merged it; it needs a fresh audit pass.
